title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 7
notes: Fresh-main deterministic top-five one-event depth batch generated from e33e4ea43ba413d8e581fb24045d24f176f1a30d. Promotion identity authority remains current canonical main; no inferred launch dates are introduced.

events.title: Specter Desktop v2.1.7 fixed an open-redirect bypass
events.description: Specter Desktop v2.1.7 was released on 2026-04-09 with a fix for an open-redirect bypass using percent-encoded characters, alongside an Electron offline-crash fix.

events.title: TokenPocket iOS 2.0.6 added Bitcoin and Dogecoin support
events.description: TokenPocket's 2023-04-14 mobile update documented iOS version 2.0.6 with Bitcoin and Dogecoin support, Bitcoin Taproot support, custom nodes, Nostr support, and additional wallet-management improvements.

events.title: Cake Wallet v4.26.0 added Monero support to wallet groups
events.description: Cake Wallet v4.26.0 added deterministic Monero wallets using a 12-word BIP39 seed inside multi-crypto wallet groups, allowing one seed phrase to restore supported assets including Monero, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Solana, Ethereum, Bitcoin Cash, Nano, and Tron.

events.title: Lace 1.24 added Bitcoin mainnet support
events.description: Input Output Global's weekly development report recorded Lace v1.24 as released with Bitcoin mainnet support, full Handle support, and Tempo.vote delegation and on-chain voting integration.

events.title: Ambire Extension launched publicly without invite codes
events.description: Ambire announced the public launch of its browser extension on 2025-05-08, ending the private-beta invite requirement and shipping EIP-7702 support for existing externally owned accounts from launch.

evidence.title: Specter Desktop v2.1.7
evidence.notes: Official GitHub release published 2026-04-09; release notes include the open-redirect bypass fix and Electron offline-crash fix.

evidence.title: Version Update (Apr 14th, 2023)
evidence.notes: Official TokenPocket mobile update log documents iOS 2.0.6 with Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Taproot, custom-node and Nostr support.

evidence.title: Cake Wallet Introduces Monero Wallet Groups, New Seed Formats, and more!
evidence.notes: First-party Cake Wallet release article documents v4.26.0 and Monero support in multi-crypto wallet groups using a BIP39 seed.

evidence.title: Weekly development report as of 2025-06-27
evidence.notes: IOG development report states the Lace team released v1.24 with Bitcoin mainnet, Handle and Tempo.vote support.

evidence.title: The Ambire Extension Launches Officially
evidence.notes: First-party Ambire announcement documents the extension leaving private beta and becoming available without invite codes with EIP-7702 support.
